name: Knowledge Graph Intelligence Platform
summary: Connects the existing Discovery experience to a typed Knowledge Graph that can rank, explain and recommend related experiences without coupling the platform core to Casa Amar.
major_changes: Knowledge Graph 2.0 with typed experience, intent and place entities
Weighted semantic relationships for direct intent matches and good combinations
Graph-assisted Discovery ranking with deterministic fallback
Explainable recommendation traversal and multi-hop graph paths
Casa Amar experience data compiled into a governed graph registry
Provider-independent architecture prepared for AI enrichment
test_focus: Search for breakfast, evening and beach and confirm existing Discovery behaviour remains stable
Confirm Hoyo 19 remains the strongest breakfast restaurant result
Open /knowledge-graph.html and confirm the graph loads without consistency errors
Verify the optional day board, drag and drop, free text and sharing still work
title: Knowledge Graph Intelligence Platform
